tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its metadata: title, description, canonical URL, language, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, icons and parsed JSON-LD blocks. Use it for link previews, SEO checks or structured data (JSON-LD) without the page body; use page_to_markdown when you need the readable tex

tools.name: crawl_site
